PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength Foundation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build bodyweight strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 60s
          hip_circles 60s
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x5..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x2..4 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
          chest_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 60s
          scapular_retraction 60s
        main straight_sets:
          reverse_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x1..3 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          push_up 3x5..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          shoulder_stretch 60s
          child_pose 60s
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          inchworm 60s
          cat_cow 60s
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x2..4 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          push_up 3x5..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          superman 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s
          spinal_twist 60s
